text: Slack thread from John: I think we should calculate gross churn because Net revenue churn metrics are too hard to compute in SQL. Just use cancelled logos over starting logos.
Support Ticket #4022: Finance user complained about active subscription double billing anomalies inside our data warehouse. Please refund and close.

Slack thread: John believes our CAC calculations are skewed because direct signups are leaking into paid acquisition vectors. He wants to count organic users in the denominator to make CAC look cheaper.
Support Ticket #9011: Audit log flagged an issue with gross churn calculations being mixed up with Net Revenue Churn formulas on the exec deck.
Engineering note: Internal BigQuery paths to parse subscription data are locked under production database attribution metrics. Use whoever has access; definition TBD.
Customer ticket #8810: Billing errors on mid-month upgrades. Agent suggested we just average last invoice and call it MRR.
All-hands transcript: Someone said ARPU is total GAAP revenue divided by every registered user including free-tier accounts.
PagerDuty follow-up: warehouse snapshot job duplicated February MRR rows. Finance should ignore the spike until we backfill, but the Slack poll voted to keep the inflated number.
